title: Y1DA--FY26: NRM (PROJ: 548-22-100) BB Remove and Replace Public  Address System
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
detail_text: PROJECT TITLE: Bid Build (BB) Remove and Replace Public Address System, Project No. 548-22-100 CONTRACT TYPE: Bid Build (BB), Firm Fixed Price PROJECT SUMMARY: The contractor shall provide all labor, tools, and materials necessary for the following work: Bid-Build project to replace the public address system in the VA Medical Center at West Palm Beach, FL, with a Networked Public Address System that is compliant with VA design manuals, design guides and specifications. Project is located at the West Palm Beach VA Medical Center, 7305 N. Military Trail, West Palm Beach, FL 33410. Period of performance is 365 days. MAGNITUDE OF CONSTRUCTION: Between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000 OFFICE ISSUING THIS REQUEST: Department of Veterans Affairs Network Contracting Office (NCO) 8 Point of Contact: Stacy Figlinski, Contracting Officer Email: Stacy.Figlinski@va.gov The Solicitation for this project will be issued on or about March 31, 2026. This project is 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB).
